description: A human head, wrapped without ceremony in whatever was to hand. Whose it is, and what it's worth, is stamped on the tag looped through the wrapping — a board printed that tag the moment the contract was written, and has been waiting for somebody to bring it back ever since.
name: wrapped head

tags.description: A wrapped head with a board's tag looped through it. Worth money at a WANTED board and nothing anywhere else.
